sentences.japanese: 世の中には10種類の人間がいる。二進法が分かる者と分からない者だ。
sentences.english: There are 10 types of people in the world: those who understand binary, and those who don't.

sentences.japanese: この世は、愚か者だらけ。
sentences.english: The world is full of fools.

sentences.japanese: 彼は世の中の事に無知だ。
sentences.english: He is ignorant of the world.

sentences.japanese: 君が居なくてはどんなにさびしい世の中になることだろう。
sentences.english: What a lonely world it will be with you away!

sentences.japanese: 我々は、新聞、雑誌、ニュース番組で世の中の出来事を知る。
sentences.english: Newspapers, magazines, and newscasts tell what is going on in the world.
